summary: Standard RST heading notation: ### with overline for parts, *** with overline for chapters, === for sections, --- for subsections, ^^^ for sub-subsections, and """ for paragraphs.
questions: Which underline characters should I use for RST headings in Ansible docs?
How do I mark a chapter heading in RST?

answer_card.title: RST heading notation
answer_card.answer_md:
- `###` with overline: parts
- `***` with overline: chapters
- `===`: sections
- `---`: subsections
- `^^^`: sub-subsections
- `"""`: paragraphs
